pattern: join two same-shape tables on an id, compute a delta, rank top five, dropouts fall out via inner join
question: top 5 kids who improved the most in situps from baseline to endline
gold_sql: SELECT b."Child Name", e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups" AS situps_improvement FROM sportathon_baseline AS b JOIN sportathon_endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" ORDER BY situps_improvement DESC, b."Child Name" LIMIT 5
sql_duckdb: WITH baseline AS (SELECT "Child ID", "Sit Ups" AS sit_ups_baseline FROM sportathon_baseline), endline AS (SELECT "Child ID", "Sit Ups" AS sit_ups_endline FROM sportathon_endline), improvement AS (SELECT b."Child ID", b.sit_ups_baseline, e.sit_ups_endline, (e.sit_ups_endline - b.sit_ups_baseline) AS improvement FROM baseline AS b JOIN endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID") SELECT "Child ID", improvement FROM improvement ORDER BY improvement DESC LIMIT 5

top 5 kids who improved the most in situps from baseline to endline
attempts.response:
WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT "Child ID", "Sit Ups" AS sit_ups_baseline
  FROM sportathon_baseline
),
endline AS (
  SELECT "Child ID", "Sit Ups" AS sit_ups_endline
  FROM sportathon_endline
),
improvement AS (
  SELECT b."Child ID", 
         b.sit_ups_baseline, 
         e.sit_ups_endline,
         (e.sit_ups_endline - b.sit_ups_baseline) AS improvement
  FROM baseline b
  JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
)
SELECT "Child ID", improvement
FROM improvement
ORDER BY improvement DESC
LIMIT 5;
